## Current friction

Which reader, workflow, or engineering decision is affected?

## Proposed change

Explain the outcome and why it helps. Corrections and removals are welcome.

## Tradeoffs

What could become less clear or less safe? Does the change introduce a stack-specific assumption?

## Example

Provide fictional or sanitized before/after wording. Do not post private project evidence or live security findings.
